IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
sleek blonde hair pulled back walks a
runway. She wears a camel
double-breasted wool coat with gold
buttons, a shawl collar with a long
matching scarf, and a self-tie belt at the
waist. Tall camel suede knee-high boots
complete the look. Her expression is
calm and direct. A dark wooden
backdrop, a violet carpet runway, and
warm stage lighting. Palette of camel,
gold, and violet. Structured and
polished, in the style of a fall runway
editorial.
